title: Indicator after shifting coordinates
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every finite set $T\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, the indicator vector of the set obtained by shifting each element of $T$ one place into $\mathrm{Fin}(n+1)$ is the vector whose initial coordinate is $0$ and whose remaining coordinates are the indicator vector of $T$.
